episode.title: Objects From Our Past
episode.tagline: Many of the objects we grew up with have disappeared with time -- and overall, progress is a damn good thing. But many of these lost objects also represent a different way of doing things and of living life, and some of that would have been worth holding on to.
episode.about: In this episode, Amit and Ajay share objects from their past -- and what they represented then and mean now.

Amit's twelve-year-old novel 'Tales of Saint Johns' opened with chapter one, 'Tantalising Tantrums', 'which at least alliterates.'
